text:
kevin: Heads-up: trying two directions for the Usage/Billing top row — a compact 'spend capsule' (single-line summary with micro-actions) vs a 'detail panel' that expands inline with filters. Posting screenshot in thread, thoughts? :mag_right:

anya: Capsule feels lighter, nice for quick checks. Worry: where do invoices live? hard to find if hidden.

maria: Could put a persistent small invoice icon in the capsule (icon-only) with aria-label "Download invoice (current scope)". Keep the heavy controls in the detail panel.

sam: Engineering note: prefer capsule opens detail panel via CSS transform (no re-fetch), avoids bundle reinit. Also watch memory use for many sparklines.

olivia: Copy suggestions:
- capsule heading: "This period spend" (not just "Spend")
- invoice CTA tooltip: "Export invoice (CSV)"
- when detail open, headline: "Spend and token breakdown (by project)"

kevin: Good. Scope UX question: capsule should reflect the active scope (project/org). Maybe small scope pill: "Scope: Project X" that toggles to "Org View".

anya: Agree. When toggled to org, capsule could show top-line org total + small sparkline; clicking the pill slides open the detail panel comparing projects.

maria: Token breakdown in capsule should be minimal: token emoji, value, % — tapping reveals a stacked list in the panel with model labels and per-model costs.

sam: Mobile concern: modals stack poorly. For small screens, capsule -> push to full-screen panel rather than modal. Also keyboard focus trap needed for panel.

kevin: Accessibility checklist (quick): aria-expanded on the capsule chevron; aria-controls pointing to panel ID; focusable icon buttons; 4.5:1 contrast for tiny sparklines.

olivia: I'll update figma with the two variants and add copy + aria strings. Example ARIA we should use:
- capsule chevron button: aria-label="Expand spend details" aria-expanded="false"
- invoice icon: aria-label="Download invoice for current scope"

anya: UX decision: persistent download anchor in capsule (icon-only) improves discovery. But keep action subtle so it doesn't compete with primary CTA.

maria: Variant suggestion: capsule-lite (icon-only download + scope pill) and capsule-plus (also shows top-3 projects as micro-badges). We can A/B those.

sam: Dev ok on both. Need final class names and keyboard handlers before handoff.

design-bot: Reminder: feature flag ready for org.invoice_export, enabled in staging.

kevin: Thanks. @olivia please paste the final copy and ARIA strings here once updated. @maria will prototype the icon-only download states. Review tomorrow 9:30am PT. :calendar:
